draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 150th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 18th of 30 at LB. He went 121st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (150th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: B.J. Goodson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 75 tackles in 2022, 13th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 32 career games and 11 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 4 (78th percentile). Weak spots: tackles for loss 0 (16th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 38 combined tackles against a median of 40, below the norm.
